का.आ. 3986(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 5195(अ) तारीख 07/12/2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग ॥, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के मुरैना जिले में ग्रीनफील्ड हाइवे 
के कि.मी. 67.820 से कि.मी. 88.200 (कार्यालय अनुविभागीय अधिकारी , राजस्व-मुरैना, जिला-मुरैना) तक के राष्ट्रीय 
राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने / चार लेन का बनाने/6 लेन, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधत और प्रचालन के लिए उस 
अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "15.12.2023" 
को "नई दुनिया " और "फ्री प्रेस " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


5978 GI/2024 (1)

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

9.0. 3986(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport

the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning/6 laning etc.), maintenance, 
management and operation of Greenfield Highway in the stretch of land from Km. 67.820 to Km. 88.200 (office of 
the Sub Divisional officer Revenue, Morena, district Morena) in the district of MORENA in the state of MADHYA 
PRADESH.

both dated 15.12.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act;

settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

conferred by the sub-section (l) section 30 of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

का.आ. 4027(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2038 (A) तारीख 21 मई 2024,जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग - 2, खण्ड - 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग संख्या 18 
के कि.मी. 0+000 से कि.मी.18+400 & राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग संख्या 140 के कि.मी. 0+000 से कि.मी. 41+800 तक के 
भूखण्ड(कुक्कलापल्ली से मल्‍लवरम सेक्शन) का निर्माण (चौड़ा करने/ छः लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंध और 
प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की 
घोषणा की थी; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन "08 जून 2024”तारीख 
को "हंस इंडिया " और "प्रजाशक्ति " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी को किसी व्यक्ति से कोई आक्षेप आपत्ति प्राप्त नहीं हुए है; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में, यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन परउक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि, सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त हो कर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 19th September, 2024 


S.O. 4027(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, number S.0.2038(E) dated 217 May 2024, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 
1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/six laning etc.,), maintenance, 
management and operation in the stretch of land from Km 0+000 to Km 18+400 on National Highway No.18 & from 
Km 0+000 to Km 41+800 of National Highway No.140 (Kukkalapalli to Mallavaram Section) in the state of Andhra 
Pradesh. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “HANS INDIA” and “PRAJA 
SAKHTY’ both dated 08" June 2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas no objection has been received from any person by the competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2757 तारीख 15/07/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग ॥, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा तेलंगाना राज्य के संगारेड्डी जिले में ग्रीनफ़ील्ड 
एक्सप्रेसवे के कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी. 9.56 (संगारेड्डी) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, 
आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के 
अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "24/07/2024 " 
को "मन तेलंगाना (तेलुगु)" और "हंस इंडिया (इंग्लिश)" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of Greenfield Expressway in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 9.56 (SANGAREDDY) in the district of

“Hans India” both dated 24/07/2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act;

S.O. 4024(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A 
of the National Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the 
Central Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief 
description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building (widening/two lane 
with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of - 346 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 5.825 (Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Revenue) Tehsil 
Raisen) in the district of RAISEN in the state of MADHYA PRADESH, hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of 
publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the 
aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, SDO 
(Revenue), Raisen in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority 
shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, 
and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the 
Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the 
said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available 
and can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent 
Authority.

New Delhi, the 9" September, 2024 


७.0. 4023(E).—Inexercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 
3A of the National Highways Act,!956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), 
the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief 
description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building (Barshitakli 
Bypass Four Lane with paved shoulder),maintenance, management and operation of 
National Highway No. 6l A at Barshitakli in the stretch of land from km. 0/00 to 
3/00 (Mahan-Akola section) in the district of Akola in the state of MAHARASHTRA, 
hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date 
of publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, raise objections to the use of such 
land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section() of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, the Sub 
Divisional Officer Murtizapur , in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the 
Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person 
or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such 
further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either Allow 
or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 
3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be covered under their notification are 
available and can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the 
Competent Authority.

New Delhi, the 9" September, 2024 


S.O. 4026(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the 
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, S.0.878(E) Dated:26/02/2024 , published in the 
Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section 
() of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as 
the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), 
maintenance, management and operation of NH2I7 in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 
5.07 (Office of the Deputy Commissioner (Revenue Branch), North Garo Hills District, 
Resubelpara) in the district of North Garo Hills in the state of MEGHALAYA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in 
“Shillong time” and “Salantini janera” both dated /5th March 2024; under sub-section (3) of 
section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 
3-C, considered and settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the 
competent authority has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in 
exercise of the powers conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the 
Central Government hereby declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be 
acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the 
Central Government hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official 
Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central 
Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[Western Railway (Construction Organization)] 
NOTIFICATION 
Mumbai, the 19th September, 2024 


S.O. 4012 (E).— In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section(I) of section 20A of the Railways Act, 
1989(24 of 1989) (hereinafter referred in as the said Act), the Central Government after being satisfied that for the 
public purpose, the land, the brief description of which has given in the schedule annexed hereto, is required for 
execution of the special Railway Project, namely Samakhiyali Gandhidham Quadrupling Project (53.00 KM) in 
District Kutch in the State of Gujarat, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land: 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for a foresaid purpose under 
sub-section (1) of section 20D of the said Act: 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, Prant Officer- Abdasa, District 
Kutch, in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the competent authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may, after hearing all such objections and after 
making such further enquiry, if any as the competent authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (II) of section 20(D) of the said act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

का.आ. 4021(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2281 तारीख 13/06/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा राजस्थान राज्य के दौसा जिले में NHNE 40 के 
कि.मी. 9.25 से कि.मी. 32.74 (कलक्टरेट आफिस, दौसा) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का 
बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन 
करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "11.07.2024" 
को "दैनिक नवज्योति" और "समाचार जगत" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपार्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 34 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी |

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 19th September, 2024 


S.O. 4021(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 2281 Dated:13/06/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NHNE 4C in the stretch of land from Km. 9.25 to Km. 32.74 (collectorate office, Dausa) in the district of DAUSA 
in the state of RAJASTHAN 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Navjyoti” and “Samachar 
Jagat” both dated 11.07.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 


settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

S.O. 4057(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for

Bypass end section) in the stretch of land from design Km. 73.750 to Km. !02.000 in the district of SEHORE in the 
state of MADHYA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer (Revenue), 
Budhni in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 19th September, 2024 


S.O. 4019(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.0.1387 (E) Dated:15/03/2024, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH208 in the stretch of land from Km. 8.44 to Km. 93.5 (Office of District Magistrate & Collector 
Gomati District) in the district of Gomati in the state of TRIPURA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Shyandan Patrika” and “North 
East Colors” both dated 15/06/2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


42 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 4054(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 7956 (956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उप-धारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात्‌ कि मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के हरदा जिले में NH59A के कि.मी. 27 से Fh. 42.445 (सब डिवीजनल 
आफिसर (रा.), हरदा, जिला-हरदा) तक के भू-खण्ड के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पेग्ड शोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/4-लेन का बनाना 
आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची 
में दिया गया है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है | 

कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा () के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्नकीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा | 

ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ सब डिवीजनल आफिसर (रा.), हरदा को लिखित रूप में प्रस्तुत की 
जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी 
विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के 
पश्चात्‌, यदि कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या 
अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा | 

उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (2) के अधीन सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश 
अंतिम होगा |

New Delhi, the l9th September, 2024 


5.0. 4054(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH59A in the 
stretch of land from Km. 27 to Km. 42.445 (Sub Divisional Officer (R), Harda, District-Harda) in the district of 
HARDA in the state of MADHYA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer (R), 
Harda in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

का.आ. 4020(अ).-- केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 956 (4956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (() के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 7343(E) तारीख 74/03/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, ATT, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा गुजरात राज्य के अहमदाबाद जिले में NH47 के 
कि.मी. 7 से कि.मी. 72. (डिस्ट्रिक्ट कलेक्टर ऑफिस अहमदाबाद) तक के भूखण्ड पर टोल प्लाजा के निर्माण, अनुरक्षण, 
प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की 
घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "40/4/2024 " 
को "संदेश" और " टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (॥) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 19th September, 2024 


S.O. 4065(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the 
National Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central 
Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of 
which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building (widening/two lane with paved 
shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH53 in the stretch of 
land from Km. 360 to Km. 422.7 (SDO office Near Court Bhusawal) in the district of JALGAON 
in the state of MAHARASHTRA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of 
publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the 
aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, SDO Bhusawal in 
writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector 
an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all 
such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks 
necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the 
said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are 
available and can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent 
Authority.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the !9th September, 2024 


S.O. 4076(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH-l68G in 
the stretch of land from Km. 34.300 to Km. 62.600 (3rd floor taluka seva sadan , kheralu) in the district of 
MAHESANA in the state of GUJARAT, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section() of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Magistrate and 
Prant Officer in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either 
allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 
The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

इसके पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उप-धारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते 
हुए, यह समाधान हो जाने के पश्चात्‌ कि गुजरात राज्य के महेसाणा जिले में NH58 के कि.मी. 85 से कि.मी .87 
(तालुका सेवा सदन तीसरी मंजिल, SI) तक के भू-खण्ड के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पेग्ड शोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/4- 
लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका 
संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है। 


कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस 
दिन के भीतर अपनी आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ उप प्रभागीय न्यायाधीश, खेरालू, जिला-मेहसाणा 
(गुजरात) को लिखित रूप मे प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम 
प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या किसी विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी 
आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात्‌, यदि कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी 
आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा |

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 19th September, 2024 

S.0.4058(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the 
National Highways Act,1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central 
Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of 
which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building (widening/two lane with paved 
shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH58 in the stretch of 
land from Km. 85 to Km. 87 (Taluka Seva Sadan 3rd floor , Kheralu) in the district of 
MAHESANA in the state of GUJARAT, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of 
publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the 
aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional 
Magistrate, Kheralu, District- Mehasana (Gujrat) in writing and shall set out the grounds 
thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either 
in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the 
said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available 
and can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l9th September, 2024 


७.0. 4063 (E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after 
being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule 
below, is required for construction of additional structure / bridges (widening / six lanning etc), 
maintenance, management and operation of NH48 in the stretch of land from Km. 44.50 to Km. 45.400 
(on Vadodara Surat Section) in district Vadodara in the state of GUJARAT, hereby declares its intention to 
acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of 
this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub- 
section(]) of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, The Deputy Collector 
Karjan, Taluka Seva Sadan, Karjan in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent 
Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, 
and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent 
Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act 
shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be Covered under their notification are available and 
can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 19th September, 2024 


S.O. 4070 (E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH744 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 59.712 in the district of KOLLAM in the state of KERALA, hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Deputy Collector - LA NH, 
Collectorate, Kollam, in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either 
allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the office of the Competent Authority.

प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप मे 
या किसी विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और जाँच 
करने के पश्चात्‌, यदि कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर

S.O. 4071(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (here in after referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation 
of NHS543 (Package -1) in the stretch of land from Km. 0+000 to 120+300 Km. (Mandla Nainpur Balaghat 
Road) (Chirai Dongari Bypass)(Taluka-Nainpur) From km. 0+000 to 46+000 km. in the district of MANDLA in 
the state of MADHYA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer (Revenue) 
Nainpur, Dist, Mandla in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, 
either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

New Delhi, the 19th September, 2024 


S.O. 4074(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act,1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two laning ect.) maintenance, management and operation of National Highway No 166 G in the Stretch of 
land from alignment LC-21 in Kokisare near Vaibhavwadi Village from Km 10/800 to Km. 13/000 in the District of 
Sindhudurg in the State of Maharashtra in EPC mode, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land; 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely,the Sub Divisional Officer 
Kankavali office, Kankavli Tal. Kankavli Dist. Sindhudurg, writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the 
Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, 
and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority 
thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

Highway in the stretch of land from Km. 20.75 to Km. 29.125 (Sub Divisional Officer,Karjat) in the district of 
RAIGAD in the state of MAHARASHTRA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer,Karjat in 
writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final.

F. No. SS-TOSP02(NOTD/1/2024-Standard-FSSAI.—The following draft of certain regulations, further to 
amend the Food Safety and Standards (Contaminants, Toxins and Residues) Regulations, 2011, which the Food Safety 
and Standards Authority of India, with previous approval of the Central Government, proposes to make in exercise of 
the powers conferred by clauses (i) and (j) of sub-section (2) of section 92 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 
(34 of 2006) is hereby published as required under sub-section (1) of section 92 of the said Act for the information of 
all persons likely to be affected thereby; and notice is hereby given that the said draft regulations shall be taken into 
consideration after the expiry of the period of sixty days from the date on which copies of the Gazette containing this 
notification is published are made available to the public. 


Objections or suggestions, if any, may be addressed to the Chief Executive Officer, Food Safety and 
Standards Authority of India, Food and Drug Administration Bhawan, Kotla Road, New Delhi- 110002 or sent on 
email at regulation @fssai.gov.in. 


Objections and suggestions, which may be received with respect to the said draft regulations before the 
expiry of the period so specified, shall be considered by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India. 


Draft Regulations 


1. These regulations may be called the Food Safety and Standards (Contaminants, Toxins and Residues) Amendment 
Regulations, 2024. 


2. In the Food Safety and Standards (Contaminants, toxins and Residues) Regulations, 2011,in Regulation 2.3 relating to 
‘Residues’, for sub-regulation 2.3.1, the following shall be substituted, namely,- 


“2.3.1. Restriction on the use of Pesticides/Insecticides: 
(1) The expression “insecticide” shall have the meaning assigned to it in the Insecticide Act, 1968 (46 of 1968). 


(2) Subject to the provisions of clause (4), no pesticide/insecticide shall be used directly on article of food except 
fumigants registered and approved under the Insecticides Act, 1968 (46 of 1968). 


(3). Tolerance limit of 0.01 mg/kg shall apply for the pesticides/insecticides which are not registered under the 
Insecticide Act, 1968 (46 of 1968) except in case of spices and culinary herbs for which Tolerance limit shall be 0.1 
mg/kg. 


(4) The pesticides/insecticides specified in column (2) of the table shall not exceed the Maximum Residue Limits 
(MRL) prescribed in column (4), for the article of food specified in column (3) of the said table, namely: -

का.आ. 4079(अ).-- केंद्रीय सरकार राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) जिसे इसीमें इसके 
पश्चात उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1 ) द्वारा प्रदत सक्तियौं का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात कि उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के कौशाम्बी जिलेमें |॥1731ए के कि. मी .49.150 सेकी.मी. 74.700 (उप - 
जिलाधिकारी , सिराथू (न्यायिक), जिला मुख्यालय - मंझनपुर (कौशाम्बी ) तक के भू-खण्ड के निर्माण (चौडीकरण / Fos 
शोल्डर सहित 2 - लेन/ 4-लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण , प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि 
अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त बर्णन निचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है , ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा 
करती है। 

कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उपधारा (1 ) के अधीन पुर्बोकत्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर शासकीय राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के 
भीतर अपनी आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा। 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात सक्षम प्राधिकारी/ उप जिलाधिकरी सिराथू (न्यायिक), जिला 
मुख्यालय - मंझनपुर (कौशाम्बी) के लिखित रूप मे प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और 
सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता के व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या किसी बिधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी 
आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात, यदि कोई हो , जैसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आबश्यक 
समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों के अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा।

इस अधिसूचना को अंतर्गत आने वाली भूमि के भूमि योजनाएं और अन्य ब्योरे सक्षम प्राधिकारी के उक्त

inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

New Delhi, the l9th September, 2024 


S.O. 4066(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH53 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 360 to Km. 422.7 (SDO Office Near Court Bhusawal) in the district of JALGAON in the 
state of MAHARASHTRA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, SDO Bhusawal in writing and 
shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, 
either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further 
enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 405(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (I) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH-54 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 85.35 to Km. !00.840 in the villages namely Malan ambari, Ambari Jhikali, Pankhar, 
Ambari Upperli, Gujrehra, Barhai, Laleshar, Malan Khas (Land Acquisition Nagrota Bagwan) in the district of 
KANGRA in the state of HIMACHAL PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 

Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 

Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, CALA CUM SDM Nagrota 
Bagwan in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the |9th September, 2024 


S.O. 4060(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (l) of section 3A of 
the National Highways ७९०,।956 (48 of |956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central 
Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of 
which is given in the Schedule below (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), 
maintenance, management and operation of NH-l68G in the stretch of land from Km. 04.4 to 
Km. !29.775 in the district of ARVALLI in the state of GUJARAT, hereby declares its intention 
to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of 
publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the 
aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub 
Divisional Magistrate and Prant Officer in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the 
Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a 
legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further 
enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of 
the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are 
available and can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent 
Authority.

किया जायेगा और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आक्षेपकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the !9th September, 2024 


S.0.4067 (E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (l) of section 3A of 
the National Highways Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central 
Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of 
which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building (widening/two lane with paved 
shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NHl30CD in the stretch 
of land from Km. 384.8 to Km. 396.8 (Vizianagaram) in the district of VIZIANAGARAM in the 
state of ANDHRA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of 
publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the 
aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, CALA RDO 
Vizianagaram in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall 
give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and 
may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the 
Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the 
said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are 
available and can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent 
Authority.

New Delhi, the 19th September, 2024 


S.0.4017 (E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the 
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, S.0.1038 (E) Dated:05/03/2024 , published in the 
Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (11) issued under sub-section (1) of 
section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said 
Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, 
management and operation of NH208 in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 8.44 (khowai) in

sambad”’ and “Bartaman tripura” both dated 13/04/2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of 
the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, 
considered and settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the 
competent authority has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise 
of the powers conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the 
aforesaid purpose; 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the 
land specified in the said Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all 
encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 19th September, 2024 


S.O. 4038(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 2414(E) Dated:03/07/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building(widening/four laning, etc.,), Maintenance, management and operation 
of NH548B in the stretch of land from Km. 80.00(Near Murgundi) to Km. 140.200 (Near Chikkodi) excluding length 
from Km 118.450 to Km 128.450 (Vijayapur- Sankeshiwar Section) in the district of BELAGAVI in the state of 
KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Vijayavani” and “Deccan 
Herald” both dated 03-07-2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 19th September, 2024 


S.O. 4053 (E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of 
the National Highways Act,1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central 
Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of 
which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building (widening/four laning etc.,), 
maintenance, management and operation of NH373 in the stretch of land from Km. 113.00 to 
Km. 128.080 (Yedegowdanahalli to Arjunahalli Section) in the district of MYSURU in the state of 
KARNATAKA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of 
publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the 
aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Assistant 
Commissioner hassan in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority 
shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, 
and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the 
Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the 
said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are 
available and can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent 
Authority.

l. ({) These rules may be called the New Drugs and Clinical Trials (Amendment) Rules, 2024.

“CHAPTER VA 
CLINICAL RESEARCH ORGANISATION 


38A. Registration of Clinical Research Organisation.- Without prejudice to anything contained in any other 
provisions of these rules, no Clinical Research Organisation shall conduct any clinical trial or bioavailability or 
bioequivalence study of new drug or investigational new drug in human subjects without registration granted by the 


Central Licencing Authority under these rules. 


38B. Application for Registration of Clinical Research Organisation.- () The Clinical Research Organisation 
shall make an application in Form CT-07B to the Central Licencing Authority for the purpose of registration for 


conducting clinical trial or bioavailability or bioequivalence study. 


Provided that any bioavailability or bioequivalence study centre already registered under rule 44, shall be 


deemed to be registered under this Chapter for the purposes of bioavailability or bioequivalence study. 


(2) The application for registration shall be accompanied by a fee as specified in the Sixth Schedule alongwith such 


documents and other information as specified in the Ninth Schedule.

38C. Grant of registration to Clinical Research Organisation.- (|) The Central Licencing Authority may, after 
scrutiny of the information and requirements furnished with the application under rule 38B and such further enquiry, if 


any, as may be considered necessary, — 


(i) if satisfied, that the requirements of these rules have been complied with, grant registration to the applicant in 
Form CT-07C within a period of forty-five working days from the date of receipt of the application; or 

(ii) if not satisfied, reject the application, for reasons to be recorded in writing, within a period of forty-five 
working days reckoned from the date of the receipt of the application ; or 

(iii) If satisfied, that any deficiency in the application is required to be rectified, it shall inform the applicant of 
the deficiency not later than forty-five working days from the date of receipt of the application, to rectify the 


deficiencies within such period as may be specified by it: 


Provided that where the applicant rectifies the deficiency within the period so specified, the Central Licencing 
Authority, shall if satisfied, grant registration to the applicant or if not satisfied, reject the application within a 


period of ninety days reckoned from date of the receipt of the rectification. 


(2) In case of rejection of application under sub-rule (), the applicant may request the Central Licencing Authority to 
reconsider the application within a period of sixty days from the date of rejection of the application on payment of fee 


as specified in the Sixth Schedule and submission of required information and documents. 


(3) Any applicant aggrieved by the decision of the Central Licencing Authority under sub-rule (.) or sub-rule (2), may 
file an appeal within forty-five days from the date of such decision, before the Central Government and Government 
may, after such enquiry and after giving an opportunity of being heard to the appellant, dispose of the appeal within a 


period of sixty days from the date of receipt of the appeal. 


38D. Validity period and renewal of registration of Clinical Research Organisation.- () The registration granted 
under rule 38C shall remain valid for a period of five years from the date of its grant, unless suspended or cancelled by 


the Central Licencing Authority. 


(2) An application for renewal of registration shall be made in Form CT-07B to the Central Licencing Authority along 


with documents as specified in the Ninth Schedule prior to date of expiry of its registration: 


Provided that if the application for renewal of registration is received by the Central Licencing Authority prior to 
the date of expiry, the registration shall continue to be in force until the orders are passed by the Central 


Licencing Authority on the application.

enquiry, if any, as may be considered necessary, if satisfied, shall renew the registration in Form CT-07C and in case 


of rejection or rectification of deficiency, if any, the procedure as specified in rule 38C shall apply.

Research Organisation registered by the Central Licencing Authority under rule 38C, shall allow any officer 
authorised by the Central Licencing Authority, who may be accompanied by an officer authorised by the State

clinical trial or bioavailability or bioequivalence study; 

(v) clinical trial of new drug or investigational new drug shall be registered with the Clinical Trial Registry 
of India before enrolling the first subject for the study; 

(vi) bioavailability or bioequivalence study of investigational new drug shall be registered with the Clinical 
Trial Registry of India before enrolling the first subject for the study 

(vii) study shall be conducted in accordance with the approved protocol and other related documents and as 
per requirements of Good Clinical Practices Guidelines and provisions of the Act and these rules; 

(viii) in case of termination of any such study prematurely, the detailed reasons for such termination shall 
be communicated to the Central Licencing Authority immediately; 

(ix) any report of serious adverse event occurring during study to the subject of such study shall, after due 
analysis, be forwarded to Central Licencing Authority within fourteen days of its occurrence in the 
format as specified in Table 5 of the Third Schedule and in compliance with the procedures as specified 
in rule 42; 

(x) in case of an injury to the study subject during study, the complete medical management and 
compensation in the case of study related injury shall be provided in accordance with the provisions of 
Chapter VI and details of compensation paid to the trial subject in such cases shall be intimated to the 
Central Licencing Authority within thirty days of receipt of the order; 

(xi) in case of death, permanent disability, injury other than death and permanent disability, as the case may 
be, of a study subject, compensation shall be provided in accordance with the provisions of Chapter VI 
and details of compensation paid to the trial subject or his legal heir, as the case may be, in such cases 
shall be intimated to the Central Licencing Authority within thirty days of receipt of the order; 

(xii) if there is any change in constitution or ownership of the Clinical Research Organisation, the 
organisation shall intimate about the change in writing to the Central Licencing Authority within thirty 
days of such change; 

(xiii)the clinical research organisation shall maintain data, records, and other documents related to the 
conduct of the clinical trials for a period of five years after completion of such study or for at least two 
years after the expiration date of the batch of the new drug or investigational new drug studied, 
whichever is later; 

(xiv)the Clinical Research Organisation shall allow any officer authorised by the Central Licencing Authority 
who may be accompanied by an officer authorised by State Licencing Authority to enter the premises 


with or without prior notice, to inspect any record, statistical observation or results or any documents

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the !9th September, 2024 


S.O. 4040(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 243(E) Dated:2/06/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for Building (Widening / four laning etc.), Maintenance, management and operation 
of NH548B in the stretch of land from Km. 8.450 (Near Shiraguppi) to Km. !28.450 (Near Ankali) (Vijayapur 
Sankeshwar Section) in the district of BELAGAVI in the state of KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Kannada Prabha” and “The 
Times of India” both dated 03-07-2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

(जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा () के अधीन जारी की

20/06/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड () में प्रकाशित की गई थी, 
द्वारा तेलंगाना राज्य के मेडक जिले में ग्रीनफ़ील्ड एक्सप्रेसवे के कि.मी. 25.304 से कि.मी. 53.095 
(नर्सापुर) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन 
और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने 
आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 
"07/07/2024" को "हंस इंडिया" और " मना तेलंगाना" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार 
किया गया है और उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l9th September, 2024 


S.O. 4034 (E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the 
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, 2387 Dated:20/06/2024 , published in the Gazette of 
India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section () of section 3A 
of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of Greenfield Expressway in the stretch of land from Km. 25.304 to Km. 53.095 
(NARSAPUR) in the district of MEDAK in the state of TELANGANA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “HANDS 
INDIA” and “MANA TELANGANA” both dated 07/07/2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A 
of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, 
considered and settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the 
competent authority has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in 
exercise of the powers conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the 
aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the 
land specified in the said Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all 
encumbrances.

संचालित करने, संभालने या हटाने या तोड़ने, हटाने, मिटाने या अन्यथा आवेदक के परिसर में वितरण 
लाइसेंसधारी की ऐसी संपत्ति पर लगाई गई मुहरों, नेम प्लेटों और विशिष्ट संख्याओं या चिहनों के साथ हस्तक्षेप 
करने के लिए अधिकृत नहीं होगा।: 

बशर्ते कि वितरण लाइसेंसधारी के ऐसे प्राधिकृत प्रतिनिधि आवेदक या उसके प्रतिनिधि की उपस्थिति के अलावा 
इस खंड 3 के अंतर्गत कोई भी कार्य नहीं करेंगे।: 


बशर्ते कि वितरण लाइसेंसधारी आवेदक को उसके परिसर में प्राधिकृत प्रतिनिधि के दौरे की पूर्व सूचना देगा, सिवाय 
उस स्थिति के जहां वितरण लाइसेंसधारी के पास यह मानने का कारण हो कि कोई व्यक्ति बिजली के अनधिकृत 
उपयोग में लिप्त है और/या ऐसे परिसर में अधिनियम के भाग XIV A प्रदत्त प्रकृति का कोई अपराध कर रहा है। 


. आवेदक वितरण लाइसेंसधारी के अधिकृत प्रतिनिधियों को मीटर पढ़ने, निरीक्षण करने, परीक्षण करने, स्थापित 


करने, हटाने या बदलने या कनेक्शन प्वाइंट को चालू या बंद करने के लिए अपने परिसर में प्रवेश की अनुमति देगा। 


4. सूचना का आदान-प्रदान 


4. वितरण लाइसेंसधारी और आवेदक, ओपन एक्सेस उपभोक्ताओं और वितरण प्रणाली से उनके कनेक्शन और उपयोग 


के संबंध में एक-दूसरे को समय पर ऐसी जानकारी प्रदान करने के लिए अपने उचित प्रयासों का उपयोग करने के 
लिए सहमत हैं, जो उनमें से किसी के पास भी हो सकती है और जिसकी दूसरे को अधिनियम, नियमों, अंतर- 
राज्यीय पारेषण और वितरण विनियमों में कनेक्टिविटी और ओपन एक्सेस या इस समझौते के तहत अपने दायित्वों 
को पूरा करने के लिए उचित रूप से आवश्यकता हो सकती है।: 


बशर्ते कि इस खंड के तहत सूचना का प्रावधान अधिनियम या उस समय लागू किसी अन्य कानून के तहत अनुरोध 
की गई ऐसी जानकारी की गोपनीयता बनाए रखने के लिए दोनों पक्षों के दायित्वों के अधीन होगा। 


. वितरण लाइसेंसधारी और आवेदक यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए उचित कदम उठाने के लिए सहमत हैं कि इस 


अनुबंध के तहत उनमें से किसी एक द्वारा दूसरे को प्रदान की गई सभी जानकारी सटीक और पूर्ण है। 


5. शासी कानून और क्षेत्राधिकार 


यह समझौता भारतीय कानूनों और उसके तहत बनाए गए नियमों द्वारा शासित होगा

कनेक्शन बिंदु में संशोधन के मामले में जैसे कि बे का पुनः आवंटन, वोल्टता स्तर का उन्नयन, आदि, किसी भी पक्ष 
द्वारा, यदि पारस्परिक रूप से सहमत हो, तो कनेक्शन अनुबंध में एक संशोधन इस तरह के संशोधन को लागू करने

the distribution licensee by the Green Energy Open Access consumer. 


Provided that the credit for banked energy shall not be permitted to be carried forward to subsequent 
months/next billing cycle and the credit of energy banked during the month/billing cycle shall be 
adjusted during the same month/billing cycle. 


Provided further that the un-utilised surplus banked energy shall be considered as lapsed at the end of 
each billing cycle and the Renewable Energy generating station shall be entitled to get Renewable 
Energy Certificates to the extent of the lapsed banked energy. 


Provided further that, the energy banked during peak TOD slots shall be permitted to draw during peak 
as well as off-peak TOD slot by paying the banking charges as specified in this Regulation. However, 
the energy banked during off-peak TOD slots shall be permitted to draw during off-peak TOD slot only. 


Provided also that withdrawal of banked energy shall be allowed only during the same month in which 
the energy has been banked.

billing period, quantum of electricity withdrawn by the Green Energy Open Access Consumer from 
such Generating Station in the billing period and net electricity qualifying for payment by the Green 
Energy Open Access Consumer for that billing period at the end of each month separately. 


If the electricity injected exceeds the electricity withdrawn during the billing period, such excess 
injected electricity shall be considered as lapsed at the end of each month and no compensation shall 
be applicable on such energy at the end of the month.

a. study the technical requirements of making Connection to the Distribution System 
b. inspect the premises which is to be connected, with prior intimation to the Applicant 


2. The Authorized Representative shall, in agreement with the applicant, fix the position of the mains, cut-outs 
or circuit breakers and meters and sanction the load for the premises: 


Provided that the service position shall normally be at an accessible location and the meter shall be fixed at a 
height so as to enable convenient reading of meter and to protect the meter from any adverse weather 
conditions. 


3. After an inspection referred to in Clause 9() above is carried out, the Distribution Licensee shall intimate the 
Applicant of the details of any works that are required to be undertaken for giving Connection, the charges to 
be borne by the Applicant thereon in accordance with Clause 0 below and list of outstanding documents and 
consents/ statutory permissions required to be obtained by the Applicant. 


4. Upon receipt of a duly complete application accompanied with the required charges, and availability of 
suitable piece of land or room and all other consents and permissions as may be required, the Distribution 
Licensee shall sanction and carry out or may also permit to be carried out the works required to Energize the 
Connection Point. 


5. The Distribution Licensee shall give, the Applicant, not less than 2 days prior notice of any tests for energizing 
the Connection and shall, immediately after energizing the Connection, notify the Applicant of the time and 
date of Connection of the facility. 


6. The Applicant shall not, prior to receipt of such notification under Clause 5 above, perform any act so as to 
import electricity from or export electricity to the Distribution system through the Connection Point. 


7. The works undertaken to provide the Connection to the Distribution System shall be maintained by the 
Distribution Licensee over the term of this Agreement. 


8. The Distribution Licensee shall be entitled to use such works to provide a Connection to any other eligible 
person or to provide supply to any Consumer of such Distribution Licensee, except if such use is detrimental 
to the Connection to the Applicant or to the use of Distribution system in relation to such Consumer.
